clues.it: Vito era nella 7ª colonna, nella 1ª riga, accanto a un regalo e a nord di Bruno.
clues.en: Vito was in the 7th column, in the 1st row, beside a present and north of Bruno.

clues.it: Sergio era nella 10ª colonna, nella 2ª riga e da solo in Salotto.
clues.en: Sergio was in the 10th column, in the 2nd row and alone in the Parlor.

clues.it: Tea era nella 8ª colonna, nella 3ª riga e a nord di Elena.
clues.en: Tea was in the 8th column, in the 3rd row and north of Elena.

clues.it: Paolo era nella 4ª riga, a nord di Dario e nella Cucina dei Biscotti.
clues.en: Paolo was in the 4th row, north of Dario and in the Cookie Kitchen.

clues.it: Carla era accanto a un regalo, ma non era accanto a delle caramelle.
clues.en: Carla was beside a present, but was not beside candy canes.

clues.it: Giada era accanto a un pupazzo di neve, a nord di Nino e nel Magazzino dei Regali.
clues.en: Giada was beside a snowman, north of Nino and in the Gift Store.

clues.it: Bruno era accanto a un camino e nella stessa stanza di Giada.
clues.en: Bruno was beside a fireplace and in the same room as Giada.

clues.it: Olga era nella 11ª colonna, nella 8ª riga e in una stanza diversa da Sergio.
clues.en: Olga was in the 11th column, in the 8th row and in a different room from Sergio.

clues.it: Dario era accanto a un pupazzo di neve, ma non era accanto a delle caramelle.
clues.en: Dario was beside a snowman, but was not beside candy canes.

clues.it: Elena era nella 1ª colonna e nella 10ª riga, ma non era accanto a una calza.
clues.en: Elena was in the 1st column and in the 10th row, but was not beside a stocking.

clues.it: LA VITTIMA. Era da solo con l'assassino.
clues.en: The Victim. Was alone with the murderer.

general_clues.en: 5 in the west half of the grid.
5 in the north half of the grid.

general_clues.it: 2 accanto a un albero di Natale.
2 accanto a un pupazzo di neve.
1 accanto a una sedia a dondolo.

steps.it: L'indizio di Vito lascia una sola casella libera: riga 1ª, colonna 7ª.
steps.en: Vito's own clue leaves a single free square: row 1st, column 7th.

steps.it: L'indizio di Sergio lascia una sola casella libera: riga 2ª, colonna 10ª.
steps.en: Sergio's own clue leaves a single free square: row 2nd, column 10th.

steps.en: Vito can only be in the 7th column: ruling it out leaves Paolo a single square: row 4th, column 5th.

steps.en: Carla can only be in the 5th row: ruling it out leaves Giada a single square: row 6th, column 3rd.
